marco: FYI Orion AI flagged an invoice issue. They canceled their Dedicated reservation on 2027-12-31 but were still billed the full monthly renewal on 2028-01-01 (INV-30021). Can billing ops take a look?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-30021 attached (2028-01-02). Amount: $9,500. Line item: Dedicated Reserved Capacity	60d commit renewal		Charge date: 2028-01-01. Payment status: Paid.
support: Ticket #81234	Cancellation request received 2027-12-31 15:22 UTC. Support confirmed cancellation 2027-12-31 16:03 UTC. Evidence attached (support log + customer confirmation).
iris: System logs show auto-renew job ran at 2028-01-01 00:05 UTC and invoiced the full month. Cancellation happened before the billing job but the job picked up cached entitlement state from cache node cn-7 that lagged. Root cause likely cache TTL bug.
sam: Quick numbers: monthly commit = $9,500. Customer used 0 days in Jan (canceled 12/31). Invoice charged full $9.5k. Proposed customer outcome: reverse full $9,500 AND apply $300 goodwill credit for the ops time. Net credit = $9,800. GLs: AR-Adj (6180), Promo-7840.
elaine: Policy: credits >$5k require VP Finance approval. Routing to @vp-finance.
vp-finance: I approve reversal and $300 goodwill up to $10k. Tag memo: "auto-renew-cache-ttl" and cost center COGS-Dedicated. :white_check_mark:
support: Adjustment created ADJ-12021. Credits queued: $9,800. Updated invoice published: INV-30021-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-12021 / AR-6180 / PROMO-7840.
marco: Draft external note to Orion: "Hi team 	 we're sorry — your cancellation processed before the renewal but an internal cache lag caused the renewal to invoice. We've reversed the full renewal charge and applied a $300 goodwill credit; your updated invoice INV-30021-v2 is published and the $9,800 credit will appear on your next statement. We're patching the cache TTL bug and will follow up with an RCA. If you need the credit sooner, ping support@redwood.com and we'll prioritize. 			- Marco, Billing Ops"
iris: Internal actions: open INC-3021 for cache TTL; tag eng-runtime and eng-infra. Add test to auto-renew job to verify entitlement state freshness.
support: Sent external message at 2028-01-02T10:12Z. Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix and explanation 	 appreciate the goodwill." Closing ticket #81234.
marco: Closing thread.
